article.title: No. 4 UConn faces Ohio State, looks for 4th straight home win
article.linkText: No. 4 UConn faces Ohio State, looks for 4th straight home win
article.story: Ohio State Buckeyes (2-1) at UConn Huskies (3-0) Hartford, Connecticut; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST LINE: Huskies -11.5; over/under is 147.5 BOTTOM LINE: No. 4 UConn hosts Ohio State aiming to prolong its three-game home winning streak. UConn finished 34-6 overall with a 15-2 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Huskies allowed opponents to score 65.2 points per game and shoot 40.3% from the field last season. Ohio State finished 5-6 on the road and 21-13 overall last season. The Buckeyes averaged 79.3 points per game last season, 34.4 in the paint, 13.8 off of turnovers and 6.7 on fast breaks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
